name: Mokose Alissa
source:
Alissa is a first-year student at the Academy. 

She received the mark of Aries, becoming one of the Angels of the Zodiac. A cheerful and energetic young lady, she always lights up the room.

She fell in love with Hitsuji after the latter kissed her out of nowhere during their first meeting (!?). The two started going out on the spot (!?!?).

Alissa is proactive to the point of defying common sense. She acts like the protagonist of a gag manga.

[Based on the description [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/1987430152348086571]provided by the author.[/url]]
